reason: This is a broad expression-runtime semantic change: it replaces the evaluation context source for builtin functions across dozens of core expression files, including vectorized paths, constant folding, distsql builtin handling, planner expression rewriting, and an executor aggfunc builder touchpoint. A context-selection mistake here can silently affect SQL correctness, warnings/session state, timezone/collation/type behavior, and plan-time vs run-time evaluation, so the blast radius is high enough to justify a deep Blocker/High-focused review.
